scope: Post-judgment slice of a US federal civil money dispute, bounded by cash: only developments that can move cash, collections, collateral or credit capacity within the analysis horizon. It ends in payment, settlement, an unresolved amount, a pending secured appeal or an uncollected balance, and never forecasts appellate merits.
design: Two Jev stages. (1) Present-state interpretation of each cited finding, hydrated with its surrounding evidence: who pays, the amount's status, which procedural events it establishes, which factors it bears on and at what level. Established events place the stage; an established waiver or payment constrains the graph. (2) Conditional forecasting: at each node, Jev returns the probability of one defined future event under named parent assumptions and a code-set window, given the relevant hydrated passages and the interpretation distributions. Code multiplies conditional probabilities along each path, draws event dates and amounts inside code-owned windows and ranges, and keeps every structurally feasible path (zero-probability paths stay available for stress).

roles.agent: Groups the accepted findings about one obligation and gives its order reference (a docket reference, checked), its nature (from `natures`), the counterparty, the amount figure (checked against the quotes) and any judgment date (checked against the quotes). Its prose never reaches Jev.
roles.jev: Answers present-state and conditional forecast questions. Never sets a date, an amount or a path.
roles.host: Hydrates evidence, asks the questions, applies stage and constraint rules, composes probabilities, simulates cash.

probability_label: Model judgment: Jev's conditional probabilities of defined future events, composed along each path by code.

natures.fee_and_cost_award: an award of attorneys' fees and costs

appeal_notice_days.citation: Fed. R. App. P. 4(a)(1)(A): notice of appeal within 30 days after entry of the judgment.

automatic_stay_days.citation: Fed. R. Civ. P. 62(a): execution on a judgment is stayed for 30 days after its entry.

supersedeas_multiple_bps.citation: Fed. R. Civ. P. 62(b): a stay pending appeal on a bond or other security. District practice commonly sets the bond above the judgment to cover interest and costs; 125% is a model parameter.

bond_collateral_share_bps.citation: Model parameter: the share of the bond a surety takes as cash collateral from the judgment debtor, locked while the appeal is pending. A bond backed by a letter of credit instead uses credit-line capacity and locks no cash.

post_judgment_interest_bps_per_year.citation: 28 U.S.C. § 1961(a): simple interest from entry of judgment at the weekly average one-year Treasury yield for the week before judgment; the range is that yield's level in mid-2024.

ruling_window_days.citation: No rule sets when a court decides a submitted matter. The pending-ruling window is the analysis horizon; the ruling date is drawn uniformly inside it.

voluntary_payment_days_after_stay.citation: Model parameter: a debtor that pays does so by 30 days after the automatic stay ends.

settlement_window_days.citation: Model parameter: a settlement at this stage is paid within 90 days of the stage's start.

settlement_share_bps.citation: Model parameter: a settlement pays 60% to 100% of the amount.

enforcement_period_days.citation: Fed. R. Civ. P. 69(a): a money judgment is enforced by a writ of execution. Model parameter: collection, when it succeeds, completes within 90 days after the stay ends.

amount_status_labels.sought: sought by a party, not fixed
amount_status_labels.estimated: estimated by a party, not fixed

events.entitlement_decided: the court has decided the payer is liable for this obligation
events.amount_fixed: the court has fixed this obligation's amount
events.judgment_entered: a money judgment for this obligation has been entered
events.appeal_filed: the payer has filed a notice of appeal against this obligation
events.stay_secured: the payer has stayed this obligation with a bond or other security

readings.stage_rules_note: The stage is the most advanced procedural event any cited passage establishes. No established event leaves the dispute outside the model, with an evidence request.

amount_finality.label: How final the amount is
amount_finality.relevance: Does the quoted text say how far this obligation's amount has progressed (claimed, briefed or submitted for decision, fixed)?
levels: No amount has been stated
An amount is claimed or requested by a party
The amount has been fully briefed or submitted to the court for decision
The court has fixed the amount

appeal_intent.label: The payer's appeal intent
appeal_intent.relevance: Does the quoted text say whether the payer will appeal this obligation?
levels: The payer accepts the judgment or says it will not appeal
The passage states no position on an appeal
The payer is considering or reserves the right to appeal
The payer states it intends to appeal
The payer has filed a notice of appeal

appeal_barred.label: An appeal of this obligation is waived or barred
appeal_barred.relevance: Does the quoted text state that the payer waived, or is barred from, appealing this obligation itself (not some other claim or order)?

debtor_resistance.label: The payer's conduct on this obligation
debtor_resistance.relevance: Does the quoted text describe how the payer has responded to this obligation or to the court's orders about it?
levels: The payer has complied promptly
The passage describes no conduct by the payer on this obligation
The payer contested or delayed but complied in the end
The payer has refused, or contested enforcement of, this obligation

debtor_liquidity.label: The payer's ability to pay
debtor_liquidity.relevance: Does the quoted text describe the payer's own cash, finances or ability to pay an amount of this size?
levels: The payer reports it cannot pay or doubts it can continue as a going concern
The payer's resources look constrained relative to the amount
The payer's resources look adequate for the amount
The payer's resources are ample relative to the amount

settlement_signals.label: Settlement signals
settlement_signals.relevance: Does the quoted text say anything about the parties settling this obligation?
levels: The passage describes no settlement discussion
A party expresses general willingness to settle, or mediation is ordered
The parties disclose active settlement negotiations
The parties have an agreement in principle or a term sheet

settle_before_ruling.question: forecast_settlement
settle_before_ruling.event: the parties settle this obligation before the court fixes the amount
settle_before_ruling.window: review date to review date + settlement_window_days

amount_fixed.question: forecast_amount_fixed
amount_fixed.event: the court fixes the amount of this obligation
amount_fixed.window: review date to the end of the analysis horizon

settle_after_judgment.question: forecast_settlement
settle_after_judgment.event: the parties settle this obligation before the appeal deadline
assumes: the amount is fixed on the judgment date
settle_after_judgment.window: judgment date to judgment date + appeal_notice_days

appeal.question: forecast_appeal
appeal.event: the payer files a notice of appeal against this obligation
assumes: the amount is fixed on the judgment date
no settlement before the appeal deadline
appeal.window: judgment date to judgment date + appeal_notice_days (Fed. R. App. P. 4(a)(1)(A))

secured_stay.question: forecast_secured_stay
secured_stay.event: the payer obtains a stay of this obligation secured by a bond or other security
secured_stay.window: judgment date to judgment date + automatic_stay_days (Fed. R. Civ. P. 62(a), (b))

security_form.question: forecast_security_form
security_form.event: how the payer secures the stay

options.cash_deposit: a cash deposit with the court (locks the judgment amount in cash)
options.surety_bond: a surety bond (the surety takes cash collateral of 50% to 100% of a bond at 125% of the amount)
options.letter_of_credit: a bond backed by a letter of credit (uses credit-line capacity of 125% of the amount, locks no cash)

assumes: the payer has appealed and obtains a secured stay

settle_during_appeal.question: forecast_settlement
settle_during_appeal.event: the parties settle this obligation while the secured appeal is pending
assumes: the payer has appealed and secured a stay
settle_during_appeal.window: stay date to the end of the analysis horizon

voluntary_payment.question: forecast_voluntary_payment
assumes: no secured stay is in place
voluntary_payment.window: automatic stay end to automatic stay end + voluntary_payment_days_after_stay

enforcement.question: forecast_enforcement_collects
enforcement.event: enforcement collects this obligation from the payer
assumes: the payer has not paid voluntarily
no secured stay is in place
enforcement.window: automatic stay end to automatic stay end + enforcement_period_days (Fed. R. Civ. P. 69(a))

outcomes.settled: Settlement paid: 60%-100% of the amount, dated inside the settlement window.
outcomes.unresolved: The amount is not fixed within the horizon: no cash.
outcomes.appeal_pending: Secured appeal pending at the horizon: the encumbrance (cash or credit capacity) stays in place.
outcomes.settled_during_appeal: Settlement paid on its drawn date; the exact encumbrance is released on that date.
outcomes.paid: Paid voluntarily: the amount plus post-judgment interest unless the amount already includes it.
outcomes.collected: Collected by enforcement: the amount plus post-judgment interest unless already included.
outcomes.uncollected: Unpaid and uncollected at the horizon: no cash.

dependence: Disputes with the same counterparty are evaluated in order, borrower-as-payer first. A later dispute's forecast questions are asked once per outcome class of the earlier one for that counterparty (the counterparty received payment within the horizon, or did not); the joint probability is P(earlier path) x P(later path | class).
constraints: Only an established fact changes the graph: an established payment ends the dispute; an established appeal waiver covering this obligation removes the appeal branch. Silence and stated intentions change nothing structurally; they are evidence for the forecasts.
